Title: Eetu (Edvard) Isto, Finnish painter, Attack, 1899
Content: :ibox:The painting shows a young woman holding a book of laws, representing Finland, being attacked by a `text(double-headed)` eagle, symbolizing imperial Russia. The painting was created in reaction to Russian policies limiting Finnish autonomy within the Russian Empire and starting a process of cultural Russification in Finland.
